document.about: True T-49-HC refrigerator spec sheet. Page 1's sidebar is a 10-item list whose `▶` bullets the font maps to the control code 0x17; its third item wraps over seven lines.

notes: #187: the control code was written into the text, and items 1 and 2, and the last two, ran together.

element.text: True’s solid door reach-in’s are designed with enduring quality that protects your long term investment.

checks.issue: An item wrapped over seven lines is farther from its neighbours than a dash-led list's reach.

element.text: Factory engineered, self-contained, capillary tube system using environmentally friendly R290 hydro carbon refrigerant that has zero (0) ozone depletion potential (ODP), & 0.02 global warming potential (GWP).

checks.issue: The last two bullets were one paragraph.

element.text: Easily accessible condenser coil for cleaning.
